ID.title: Managed asset identity
ID.source_interpretation: A factory product type identifies plug-in type. A managed asset has a UUID and a changeable name. A subordinate sensor ID is scoped to the asset. None is sufficient evidence of a serial number.

MED.title: Consumer interface and plug-in
MED.source_interpretation: Asset is the consumer interface. AssetProxy implements custom interactions. A managed asset may represent equipment with several sensors.

LIFE.title: Discovery, activation and availability
LIFE.source_interpretation: Discovery proposes found assets and the directory manages instances. Asynchronous activation has transitional and failure states. Capture or command behavior while inactive is plug-in dependent.

CAP.title: Product capabilities
CAP.source_interpretation: A factory publishes capabilities for a product. Optional supported fields and ranges describe what may be supplied. A declared ability does not report its current value.

ATTR.title: Core and plug-in attribution
ATTR.source_interpretation: On the asset persist path the core supplies controller ID, store version, test-mode flag and managed asset identity. It creates observation UUID and creation time when missing. Spatial overrides depend on configuration and sensor key. Merge bypasses enrichment.

OBS.title: Observation identity, subject, value and time
OBS.source_interpretation: The observation envelope separates record UUID, asset UUID, controller ID, optional sensor ID, observed time and creation time. It can relate observations and carry a typed result.

CMD.title: Commands, responses and unsolicited updates
CMD.source_interpretation: Command and response structures may identify a sensor. The response-update event may describe a change without a preceding command.

STATUS.title: Reported condition
STATUS.source_interpretation: Status supports a summary, component conditions, run time, battery and temperature. The capability flags for providing these fields have a different subject.

ENV.title: Environmental observations
ENV.source_interpretation: Weather has explicit atmospheric, surface and water fields. WaterQuality defines separately typed sample quantities. A common scalar representation does not make different phenomena equivalent.

POWER.title: Power observations
POWER.source_interpretation: A declared source, measurement window, aggregate and load quantities have separate roles. Nominal limits are separate from observed values.

MEDIA.title: Recorded media and supporting measurements
MEDIA.source_interpretation: Image, video, audio and channel metadata describe the captured material, timing or format. Capability ranges alone cannot establish recorded media.

STORE.title: Storage and retrieval
STORE.source_interpretation: Persistence, merge and query serve distinct purposes. Query filters identify the subject or time range of stored records.

SPECIAL.title: Specialized observation and command families
SPECIAL.source_interpretation: Specialized schemas were indexed. Comparisons are bounded to descriptive meanings and source standing. Evidence for unexamined details remains open.

new_rows.label: Observation field assignment during creation and merge
new_rows.meaning: Identify fields assigned by the core, values supplied only if missing and fields preserved on merge. Use the write path to qualify provenance.
new_rows.loss: The source of a whole assertion does not say who supplied each field or whether an earlier value was preserved.

new_rows.label: Authority for recorded asset or sensor position and orientation
new_rows.meaning: Record whether the core manages the position or the plug-in supplies it. On the persist path the core can apply sensor-keyed coordinates and orientation when configured to do so.
new_rows.loss: An override value alone does not identify who is responsible for supplying spatial metadata on a particular record.

new_rows.label: Controller test mode at observation creation
new_rows.meaning: Record whether the controller was in test mode when the observation was created. Preserve this separately from a simulated or substituted individual reading.
new_rows.loss: Controller mode and substitution of a particular value are independent facts.

new_rows.label: Optional subordinate sensor identifier and sensor-specific capture support
new_rows.meaning: Associate an optional asset-scoped sensor key with a record. Separately declare whether capture can select a sensor and whether the observation can carry the key.
new_rows.loss: A channel address alone does not say whether capture is selectable and whether the returned record can identify the subordinate sensor.

new_rows.label: Device response update without a preceding request
new_rows.meaning: A plug-in can publish an updated response-shaped value after a change occurring without a command. An interface can display the new value without attributing it to a user request.
new_rows.loss: An acknowledgment or outcome does not cover an unsolicited update with the same response vocabulary.

new_rows.label: Managed asset activation transitions and failure state
new_rows.meaning: Distinguish activating, activated, deactivating and deactivated from the requested transition, its failure and actual equipment power. Inactive capture behavior depends on the plug-in.
new_rows.loss: A reported activity flag loses transitional and failure semantics and the distinction between managed state and physical power.

new_rows.label: Time until the next expected status report
new_rows.meaning: A status report can predict the delay until the next report in milliseconds. A consumer can use this for a specific expectation.
new_rows.loss: A regular reporting interval is a policy. The prediction accompanies an individual status report.

new_rows.label: Elapsed time since the current asset power-on
new_rows.meaning: Report elapsed time since the asset was turned on. The current run can be shorter than its cumulative lifetime powered duration.
new_rows.loss: A cumulative counter and an elapsed-time counter reset on different events.

new_rows.label: Power event duration and asset versus load active and reactive power
new_rows.meaning: The power event records duration, can distinguish active watts from reactive volt-amperes at the measured and load levels, and describes its sources.
new_rows.loss: AC voltage alone gives neither real/reactive power nor load attribution and duration.

new_rows.label: Recording activity and remaining or accumulated archive time
new_rows.meaning: Internal archive status can distinguish recording in progress, available recording time and time already spent archiving.
new_rows.loss: Storage capacity alone gives no elapsed archiving duration or current recording activity.

new_rows.label: Accumulated precipitation depth

qualified_comparisons.SAREF and WoT: Compare L509/M509 and L515/M515: SAREF relates a unit to its kind and a service to a function. WoT describes an exposed interaction. OSUS-R additionally identifies the managed asset, factory type, proxy and optional subordinate sensor key. A factory type can describe software. None alone identifies the physical probe.
qualified_comparisons.similar quantity: Weather.solarRadiance uses J/m². A comparison with irradiance in W/m² needs an interval and a justified conversion. The existing row is unresolved.
qualified_comparisons.product example: The pinned BMP180 example declares a weather modality, capture support, no built-in test and no observed timestamp availability. Its capture implementation constructs a weather result with temperature and pressure. These are properties of an example, not universal equipment behavior.
qualified_comparisons.equipment case: ClimaVue + CR1000X is a documentary comparison. If a record identified the logger as the managed asset, only an explicit association and suitable sensor key would support attributing the reading to the ClimaVue. The core can populate asset identity, creation time and spatial metadata. No OSUS deployment, installed plug-in, runtime transaction or sensor-to-key mapping is established for the case.

classification_policy: Direct/partial describe semantic alignment. Common and specialized fills describe reusability. The unresolved fill retains the conflicting quantity basis.
